about_the_game:
Train Plus | DLC: Kōwa Dentetsu "Regular Colors" Train

Enhance your Train Plus experience by adding the iconic "Regular Colors" train from Kōwa Dentetsu! Take control of this flagship vehicle and feel the power of a true workhorse of the rails.

Please Note:
This is downloadable content. The base game, Train Plus, is required to play.

About This Train

The Kōwa Dentetsu 4050 series in its "Regular Colors" is the cornerstone of Kōwa Dentetsu’s fleet—its most produced and celebrated train. Enjoy the authenticity and legacy of this celebrated model in your operations!

Rev up your engine and hit the tracks with the quintessential Kōwa Dentetsu experience!
